name: web-grid-system-spec-with-blush-columns-and-pill-labels
title: Grid system page with soft blush columns and floating pill measurements
whatItIs: A light grey page titled Grid System with two rounded frames, desktop and mobile, each holding pale vertical columns tinted with a soft pink glow. White pill labels float over them naming gutters, margins and column counts, with black pills giving the widths (1440px and 375px).
whatItMeans: Calm and easy to understand; the soft glow turns dry specs into a gentle visual.
techniques: Show columns as rounded translucent bars on a pale frame.
Label measurements with white pills and small double arrows.
Use black pills for the total widths.
Add a faint coloured glow behind the columns.

vocabulary.definition: A vertical strip representing one grid column.
A capsule labelling a size such as a gutter.
A dark pill stating the frame width.
A faint coloured bloom behind elements.
